There is no difference between the two, both are equally preposterous.

Both are the same: Claiming something without any scientific basis. We could be a simulation for all we know, but nobody should claim it as fact. What makes me biased or ignorant wanting scientific proof where there is none?  We are ALL equally ignorant as to the creation of the universe, and no sun god story can explain it away. Claiming intelligent design is no different than a caveman seeing fire for the first time and coming up with a story to explain something, that is to him, supernatural.

Show proof of metaphysical reality. If you say you cant provide proof, then how do you know it exists at all? Why is it ok for science to explain most things more and more, but when it comes to creation, it has to be some magical concept all of a sudden? Science explains everything, it also tells us what we DONT know, which is huge compared to the religious or spiritual who claim knowing things based on nothing. Its okay to not know everything about the universe. We dont need to try and come up with magic explanations on things we dont know yet. Maybe one day we will. For now, we should look for the truth, not philosophical theories based on nothing but intuition and stories written in books.

Winning the lottery 50 times in a row has mathematical odds. Its unlikely, but possible. You dont need the supernatural for it to happen. The same goes for matter popping into existence. Its entirely possible without a prime mover, intelligent force, space aliens or the flying spagetti monster. (see: a popular science book on the origins of the universe) We dont even know if there was a "beginning". It may have always been. What sign tells you there was a beginning?  You cant go beyond science; its not a "thing"; its a way of observing your environment to learn more through proof. If you need to look for signs, its obvious you are looking for something that isnt there.

Why am I here? What is morally right? are social human questions that have nothing to do with what is or what is not, like the creation of the universe.  Morality is a social construct based on your interaction with other humans, making it supernatural when something less probable happens is also made up. Why does something happening that is subjective (what makes winning the lotto twice vs 5 times more or less unreasonable? They are all possible) Science shows us things that we know, or can know, and tells us when we are wrong, where we need to shine new light somewhere to discover new laws that make things work.  The church used to think that the universe revolved around the earth, now the pope is on record saying natural selection is real. Science is pushing these falsehoods back slowly.
